title: Purportedly AI-Generated Calls Impersonating Banks Reportedly Helped Steal €380,000 from Customers in the Netherlands
summary: Scammers allegedly used AI-generated bank-warning recordings to draw people in the Netherlands into calls with impersonators posing as bank staff. Victims were reportedly persuaded to install an app that relayed their bank cards' contactless data to accomplices at cash machines or payment terminals. Police reportedly documented about 170 victims and €380,000 in losses during three weeks of server monitoring.
